patterns: Thune's unopposed re-election as Senate GOP leader was the day's dominant story line: 54 hits (~1.61M views) at a 6.3% combined like rate. The reach went to news-style 'asked why...' quote posts ('THUNE SURRENDERS IN ADVANCE' ~103k at 2.5%, 'GOP SENATORS JUST REWARDED FAILURE' ~97k at 3.4%). The likes went to short angry one-liners: 'We lose the Senate Majority because of John Thune... WTF?' ~57k at 14.9%, '40 MILLION signatures' ~49k at 15.1%, 'not donating a penny' ~48k at 12.8%

Bessent and Iran threats were the biggest single headline: 7 hits (~487k). rawsalerts' 'Bessent has reportedly moved to a military base' topped the board at ~258k (1.7%), and Gunther's 'IRAN IS AFTER HIM' version got ~104k at 10.0%
Hegseth wins as the impeachment goes back to committee: 11 hits (~309k) at 7.7%. 'Pete Hegseth WINS. Massie loses.' got ~65k at 10.1%, and 'Final score. Hegseth 1 Massie 0' ~32k

Gunther's 'Hey @grok' questions again won raw reach but almost no likes: 7 hits (~338k) at 0.6%. The '72 hours dark' question got ~151k (0.8%); the deadliest animals, Grand Canyon and warships questions each got ~40-47k at about 0.3-0.4%
Veterans Day posts: 11 hits (~168k) at 5.7%. Leaders were the 'To the American Veteran' letter (~27k at 9.5%) and the bald eagle 'God Bless America' zoo clip (~25k at 10.5%)
Deport/punish one-liners keep the best like rates: 'DEPORT ROBERT GARCIA.' ~79k at 14.8%. Tim Burchett for Senate posts ran at 14-15%

House leadership changeover (Jordan beats Scalise, Emmer as whip, Jeffries and veto taunts): 12 hits (~288k) at a low 2.6%. alx's best was 'John Thune just thinks we're all being paid to post about him' (~34k)
virals_narrative: The outsider AI sweep (last ~48h, ~20 unique posts) was all about the model race after Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Google's Gemini 4 Carbon went wide. @ArtificialAnlys reported Fable 5.2 taking #1 on its Intelligence Index v5 at 65 (~258k views, the only outsider post near the watchlist's reach). @Angaisb_'s 'Fable 5.2 completely destroyed Gemini 4 Carbon' got ~62k, and a string of benchmark posts each got ~12-32k (GameFeel Bench, bug-hunt, APEX-Agents, FrontierSWE, and the Chrome dino test). Gemini 4 Carbon took #1-2 on CursorBench (~2k). @testingcatalog's daily brief (~36k) was forecasting GPT-6.2 Sol/Astra this week. Smaller lanes were Anthropic's IPO roadshow and AI briefings. X News themes were Amodei warning about entry-level white-collar job cuts, the 'AI slop' label debate, developers as 'factory engineers' for AI agents, and England's regulator urging paper exams to stop AI cheating. Gunther's @grok questions ('72 hours dark' ~151k) were the closest AI-adjacent watchlist hits.
narrative_synthesis: Tuesday-to-Wednesday window: John Thune's unopposed re-election as Senate GOP leader swamped the board, with 54 of 194 hits. Short 'fire him / stop donating' one-liners earned 12-15% like rates, while news-style quote posts got the most raw reach. The Bessent-Iran threat report was the top single post (rawsalerts ~258k). Hegseth's impeachment going back to committee became a 'Hegseth wins' victory lap. On Veterans Day morning the board turned to tribute posts at moderate reach. Gunther's '@grok' questions kept pulling views with almost no likes. House GOP leadership changes (Jordan, Emmer) drew low like rates. Volume was 195 originals (Gunther 182, alx 12, rawsalerts 1).
